notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: Bugfix (v0.12.9)
notes.notes:
Tales From The Unending Void now supports Lovense. So if you have a device, you can link it up with the game and get yourself stimulated with tailored patterns for your toy of choice. 

I have good news for you if you don't own a Lovense device, or if you're in the market for another toy. To celebrate the launch of this update, I've partnered up with Lovense and we're able to offer you a whopping 55% discount on any purchase made using this affiliate link.

A Traditional Chinese translation is now also available in the game.

Changelog
- Add Lovense integration
- Add Traditional Chinese translation
- Update translations

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: Bugfix (v0.12.8)
notes.notes:
This was going to be a much more upbeat update post, but the recent storm raging through the adult gaming world here on Steam and elsewhere has struck a rather sour note. This update contains some change to comply with Steam's recently updated content guidelines. I haven't made these changes lightly and I'd rather not make them, but I don't think it can be prevented at this point.

Other than that this update adds a log of the choices you've made in the game, as well as episode summaries. Another thing I'm very happy about is the Simplified Chinese translation and French translation (the latter courtesy of Rory-Mercury91).

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release this year!
notes.notes:
It's happening! 

Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release here on Steam this year. The last episode of the season is currently in active development and once it's finished the entire season will be published on Steam.

Season Two picks up after the finale of the first season and you'll be able to continue the adventures of the Iron Bastard's crew. The second season contains episode 13 through 22 and includes bonus sex scenes, an updated walkthrough and extra artwork.

Please be sure to wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612990/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_2

Release Date
Once development of Episode 22 is finished and everything is ready to be published on Steam, I will announce the final release date of the second season.

Separate game vs. DLC
The second season is a standalone game, but you'll be able to import your end-of-season season from Season One, which will carry over the choices you've made. Alternatively there's the option to fill out a short questionnaire where you'll be able to select the most important choices. Releasing the game as DLC is something I've investigated, but the technical implications of this scenario (maintaining localizations and code interoperability across versions) made me decide against going this route.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.6 (Bugfix)
notes.notes:
The game now runs on the latest version of the engine, which should hopefully fix the troubles with Steam Deck some users have been reporting. Some render and continuity fixes in this bugfix, it's now also possible to view the extra scenes in the gallery by character instead of per episode.

The game is now also available for macOS, but please not that the builds are not notarized, so GateKeeper will probably complain when running the game for the first time.

Thanks a lot to Nebula for providing an improved version of the Italian translation.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.4 (Bugfix)
notes.notes:
This release fixes the Steam achievements, which were broken in v0.12.3. Completed achievements should trigger retroactively when starting the game (based on my limited testing).

If achievements still don't trigger after the update to v0.12.4, you should verify the integrity of the game cache. as it seems that the Steam client doesn't always overwrite the necessary files for the fix to work.

- Fix Steam achievements
